jobs.description:
In this role, you will have the opportunity to ensure patient safety and regulatory compliance across the full product lifecycle for Hospital Patient Monitoring Portfolio by supporting medical product safety surveillance, adverse event reporting, and proactive risk management activities. You will contribute to timely and accurate safety reporting to regulatory authorities and internal stakeholders, analyze safety data from clinical and post‑market sources, and collaborate cross‑functionally to identify, assess, and mitigate potential safety risks. Your work will play a key role in safeguarding patient well‑being and maintaining compliance with global regulatory standards. Please apply in English.

Your Job

- Support the timely and accurate evaluation, documentation, and reporting of adverse events from multiple sources, including post‑market surveillance, literature reviews, and real‑world data, in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.
- Analyze safety data from clinical trials and post‑market surveillance to identify potential safety signals, trends, and emerging risks, enabling early detection and proactive risk mitigation actions.
- Assist in the preparation and submission of safety reports and safety‑related content for regulatory submissions and key documents such as Risk‑Benefit Analyses (RBA), Clinical Study Reports (CSR), protocols, and Clinical Evaluation Reports (CERs).
- Collaborate with cross‑functional teams during product development and post‑market phases to assess safety risks and contribute to the development and implementation of effective risk management strategies.
- Conduct scientific literature reviews and ongoing safety surveillance activities to identify new or evolving safety issues and ensure continuous compliance with regulatory standards.
- Respond to safety‑related inquiries from healthcare professionals, patients, and internal stakeholders, ensuring transparent, accurate, and professional communication regarding product safety.
- Support the implementation and continuous improvement of safety‑related processes, policies, and procedures, and maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of evolving medical device safety regulations and guidelines.

You should bring the following

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Medical Science, Nursing, Clinical Science, or an equivalent discipline.
- 7-10 years of experience in Medical or Clinical Affairs within the Medical Devices or Biotech industry.
- Clinical experience in adult or pediatric ICU, operating room, or telemetry environments
- Willingness and ability to travel internationally approximately 10–25% annually for internal and external meetings.

Technical & Functional Skills

- Regulatory Compliance
- Risk Management and Risk‑Benefit Analysis
- Safety Assessment & Surveillance
- Adverse Event Reporting and Signal Detection

We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly’s operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

- Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
- Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
- Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
- Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
- Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
- Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
- Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
- Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

- Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
- Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
- Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
- Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.
- Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.
- Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
- Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

- DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
- Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
- GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
- Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.
- Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.
- Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

What we offer you

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

- Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.
- Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.
- Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.
- Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.
- A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.

About Smartly

Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.

We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.

Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. The Director, Sales Operations — DACH is a senior leadership role responsible for the operational effectiveness, productivity, and go-to-market efficiency of Mitel's sales organization across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. The role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, partnering directly with DACH Sales Leadership to drive performance through world-class processes, data-driven insight, and operational rigor.

Reporting to the Group Director, Sales Operations International, the Director will lead a dedicated DACH Sales Operations team and work in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, and the global Revenue Operations function. This is a high-visibility role with direct impact on revenue, growth, and organizational effectiveness across one of Mitel's most strategically important regions.

Job Responsibilities

1. Sales Planning, Forecasting & Quota Management

- Lead sales forecasting, planning, and budgeting processes across the DACH region, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment with global Revenue Operations standards
- Design and own the equitable allocation of sales quotas across all DACH channels and resources, ensuring every team member is set up to succeed and all objectives are assigned on time
- Proactively monitor planning quality and process consistency; coordinate planning activities with Finance, HR, and global Sales Operations as required
- Attend and actively contribute to ELT forecast reviews, bi-weekly regional forecast reviews, and Close the Gap sessions, providing data-driven analysis and actionable recommendations
- Responsible for theatre communications within the DACH sales organisation on process, programmes, and initiatives

2. Go-to-Market Coverage & Territory Optimisation

- Design and optimise go-to-market coverage models across the DACH region, ensuring the right sales resources are deployed against the highest-value market opportunities
- Lead account segmentation initiatives — analysing firmographic, revenue, and growth-potential data to classify accounts and align them to the most effective sales motions
- Own sales representative and channel assignment frameworks, balancing workload, market potential, and specialisation to maximise revenue per head and overall regional ROI
- Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to model territory design scenarios, simulate revenue impact, and make data-driven recommendations on coverage changes
- Continuously monitor coverage efficiency metrics including whitespace analysis, account penetration rates, and capacity utilisation to identify and act on growth opportunities

3. Channel Integrity & Direct/Partner Segregation

- Define, document, and enforce clear rules of engagement between Mitel's direct sales force and channel partners, ensuring unambiguous account ownership and minimising conflict across DACH
- Own and maintain the account segmentation framework that determines which accounts are served direct versus through channel, based on criteria including account size, strategic value, geography, and partner capability
- Establish and govern escalation and arbitration processes for channel conflict, acting as the neutral arbiter when direct and partner routes overlap or compete for the same opportunity
- Work with Sales Leadership and Channel Management to implement systematic account tagging and CRM controls that enforce segregation policies and provide full visibility into coverage boundaries
- Conduct regular audits of direct and partner account assignments to detect and resolve boundary violations, ensuring compliance with Mitel's channel programme terms
- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Channel Programme teams to ensure compensation and incentive structures reinforce the segregation between direct and indirect sales motions

4. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

- Proactively identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the sales process, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational rigour across DACH
- Lead process definition and documentation for DACH Sales Operations, including approval policies, PreSales workflows, and Service processes — developing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and ensuring cross-functional alignment
- Facilitate cross-departmental workshops to define, align, and continuously improve Sales Operations processes in collaboration with Finance, Legal, HR, and IT
- Working with Sales Leaders and Marketing, implement internal sales SPIFFs and Partner Rewards programmes, managing the delivery tools
- Own and deliver process training programmes for Sales, PreSales, and Sales Management teams across DACH — preparing materials, conducting sessions, and monitoring adoption

5. Technology, Reporting & Business Intelligence

- Own the deployment and optimisation of enabling technologies including CRM across the DACH region — ensuring data integrity, compliance with global standards, and maximum ROI from Mitel's technology investments
- Monitor the accuracy and efficient distribution of sales reports and intelligence essential to the DACH sales organisation; recommend revisions to existing reports or develop new reporting tools as needed
- Build and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports that give DACH Sales Leadership the intelligence needed to make fast, well-informed decisions
- Participate in DACH Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) calls, providing Sales data and CRM insights to inform supply chain and inventory planning
- Coordinate CRM data and process alignment with the DACH Marketing team to support campaign execution, pipeline generation, and lead management

6. Deal Desk Oversight & Bid Approval Management

- Provide leadership and strategic oversight of the DACH Sales Deal Desk — ensuring accurate Named Account checks, partner certification verification, competitive analysis, and deal matrix generation for the indirect channel pipeline
- Govern the Bid Approval Management process for the DACH region, overseeing Executive Deal Reviews (Level 1), coordinating approvals in Salesforce, and maintaining thorough documentation and filing of all bid decisions
- Define and continuously refine Deal Desk processes and rules of engagement, managing escalations and ensuring cooperation between direct sales, channel teams, and deal desk resources
- Conduct Named Account list reviews on a regular basis, ensuring accurate maintenance and alignment with agreed direct/indirect coverage boundaries

7. Sales Incentive Compensation

- Provide input to senior leadership in the development and administration of sales incentive compensation programmes for the DACH region
- Working with Finance, HR, and the global Revenue Operations team, provide assistance with sales incentive compensation administration — including arbitration and clarification of compensation policy application
- Ensure compensation and incentive structures are aligned to reinforce go-to-market strategy and channel segregation objectives

8. Governance, Management Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Support the DACH leadership team in Risk Control Board activities, audit processes, and governance obligations — acting as the Sales Operations representative in regional management forums
- Act as a key liaison between DACH Sales management and global Revenue Operations/Sales Operations leadership, ensuring regional priorities are well represented and global programmes are effectively localised
- Partner with the Service organisation on sales campaign coordination and deliver ad-hoc CRM-based sales reports to support Service planning activities
- Direct and support the consistent implementation of company initiatives across the DACH sales organisation
- Build peer support and strong internal relationships with key management personnel across Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal, and IT

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional experience (5+ years in B2B sales, sales operations, or sales management)
- Proven track record leading analytically complex Sales Operations or Revenue Operations initiatives with demonstrable business impact
- Deep expertise in CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), sales analytics, and operational tooling
- Strong experience in quota design, territory modelling, and go-to-market coverage optimisation
- Experience managing or overseeing formal bid and deal approval processes in an enterprise B2B environment
- Demonstrated ability to manage channel partner relationships and enforce rules of engagement in a direct/indirect sales model
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to influence and present confidently at all organisational levels

jobs.occupation: Lead Global HR Governance, Systems & Processes (f/m/d) (Leiter/in - Personal)
jobs.description:
BERNER pushing the limits – for those who dare more
Making a choice about your career and your employer is a choice about your future - a future where you will invest your passion and a large portion of your time, energy, and capacity.  

Are you ready to drive innovation and lead our company to new heights? We are looking for a dynamic and experienced professional to join our team and make a significant impact.

YOUR TASKS 

- Manage key global HR projects 
- Enable organizational steering through data insights and analytics 
- Ensure HR standards, policies, processes are in place and aligned with HR strategy 
- Establish and maintain appropriate and effective global HR governance rules (in alignment with other HR and non-HR functions) 
- Define global labor law related governance standards 
- Gatekeeper for HCM system and overarching HR process architecture (particularly reflected in Workday) 
- Competence Centre for Compensation and Benefits 
- Ensure HR compliance (e.g., CSRD) by leading the implementation, managing ongoing processes, and driving continuous improvement to meet legal HR requirements (such as CSRD or the EU Pay Transparency Act)

YOUR PROFILE  

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, or related field 
- Several years of progressive HR experience including global governance and HR systems management 
- Proven track record in designing and implementing global HR frameworks, policies, and compliance standards 
- Experience in managing cross-functional projects and driving HR transformation initiatives on an international scale 
- Expertise in HRIS platforms (e.g. Workday) and HR process design 
- Solid knowledge of HR analytics and reporting tools 
- Expertise in strategic HR planning and program management methodologies 
- Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across diverse cultural environments 
- Analytical mindset with ability to interpret data and provide actionable insights 
- Ability to lead global initiatives and to thrive in a fast-paced, matrix organization. 
- Fluency in English 

**WHY BERNER?** 

- Job bike leasing (JobRad)  
- Commuting allowance  
- Wellpass membership & corporate benefits  
- Company pension scheme  
- Opportunities for further training  
- Technically modern equipped workplace  
- Free beverages and fresh fruit at the workplace  
- Company restaurant in Künzelsau or meal vouchers in Cologne  
- Attractive conditions for our products in the BERNER online shop 

**Apply Now – We’re Excited to Meet You!** 

Please submit your application via our online form, including your availability and salary expectations. 

The BERNER Group is a European trading company serving professionals in the mobility, construction, and industrial sectors. We are the leading B2B specialist and an innovative manufacturer of chemical products. Our purpose is: 
“We are pushing the limits of the possible for the shapers of a better tomorrow.” 
With our strong brands - BERNER, BTI by BERNER, and CCS - we empower our customers to keep their businesses running successfully. 

**Join our team and shape the future with us!** 

The BERNER Group as employer, dare to differentiate ourselves and provide every employee the opportunity to and enable them to dare to be more.  Together, we push our own limits and contribute to shape a better tomorrow.

BERNER pushing the limits – for those who dare more
Making a choice about your career and your employer is a choice about your future - a future where you will invest your passion and a large portion of your time, energy, and capacity.  

We are the leading B2B specialist and innovative manufacturer of chemical products.  Furthermore, we deliver over 100.000 premium products for repair, care and maintenance to our customers in the mobility, construction and industrial sectors to keep their business winning and running. In addition, with our strong brands BERNER, BTI by BERNER and CCS, we offer industry-leading services that enable our customers to focus on their business and drive it forward.

- Drive the strategic professionalization and harmonization of our field sales organization across all subsidiaries

- Establish leadership frameworks and standards for field sales, including co-drives, performance reviews, and coaching to ensure consistent leadership quality
- Conceptualize and drive strategic productivity improvement initiatives to enhance field sales efficiency (e.g. IT tooling landscape, standard operating procedures, trainings)
- Collaborate with HR to define role profiles, training requirements, and career paths in field sales, supporting long-term talent development
- Collaborate with local Heads of Division/Sales, and support management by developing and regularly reviewing KPIs in cooperation with HR and Controlling
- Create frameworks for customer feedback and sales quality control, in partnership with global inside sales strategists to ensure customer-centric excellence
- Lead and/or contribute to global sales projects and initiatives, working closely with local and global sales teams
- Design and align global sales incentives, in collaboration with local sales and segment/channel managers to drive motivation and performance
- Develop strategic concepts and enablement approaches to empower our 4,500 field sales entrepreneurs across subsidiaries, ensuring they have the frameworks, tools, and strategic direction needed to succeed in the market

YOUR PROFILE

- University degree in Business Administration, Sales Strategy with a commercial focus, or a comparable field
- Proven experience in B2B sales environments, ideally with a global or regional scope
- Strong understanding of the realities and challenges of field sales, ideally gained through hands-on experience in sales or close collaboration with field sales organizations
- Experience in developing and implementing sales strategies and performance frameworks (e.g. in management consultancy or a strategy department)
- Experience in field sales operations and process optimization
- Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and inspire cross-functional teams
- Assertive and confident communicator with strong stakeholder management capabilities
- Excellent negotiation skills in both German and English (business fluent)
- Strong customer focus and interpersonal sensitivity
- Comfortable working in matrix organizations and contributing to global initiatives
- Strategic thinker with hands-on execution capabilities
- Strong analytical skills and a KPI-driven mindset
- Experience in field sales operations and process optimization
- Collaborative and inclusive leadership style

WHY BERNER?

- permanent contract

- Cologne: Pluxee food vouchers (formerly Sodexo)

- company pension scheme and employee purchase with attractive conditions
- many training and development opportunities within our future-oriented company

We are looking forward to your application!

The BERNER Group as employer, dare to differentiate ourselves and provide every employee the opportunity to and enable them to dare to be more.  Together, we push our own limits and contribute to shape a better tomorrow.
